# Enlightened Recovery

> Luxury addiction treatment and mental health recovery centers across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Michigan offering holistic, trauma-informed care.

Enlightened Recovery operates multiple treatment facilities specializing in substance abuse and dual-diagnosis treatment with programs tailored for specific populations including women, men, veterans, first responders, LGBTQ+ individuals, students, and healthcare professionals. The organization emphasizes evidence-based therapeutic approaches including CBT, DBT, and intensive outpatient programming.

## Key Topics

- Addiction Treatment
- Substance Abuse Recovery

## Core Services & Treatment Programs

- [Drug and Alcohol Rehab in New Jersey | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com): Enlightened Recovery homepage offering luxury rehab in NJ, PA, MI
- [Holistic Rehab in New Jersey | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/about-us/our-approach): Enlightened Recovery's holistic treatment philosophy and approach
- [Rehab for Women in New Jersey | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/rehab-for-women): Specialized women's rehab program with trauma-informed care
- [Rehab for Men in New Jersey | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/rehab-for-men): Men's rehab program using CBT and DBT therapeutic approaches
- [Rehab for Veterans in New Jersey | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/rehab-for-veterans): Veterans' rehab with PTSD and addiction treatment specialization
- [Addiction Treatment for First Responders in New Jersey](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/addiction-treatment-for-first-responders): First responders' addiction treatment with trauma-focused therapy
- [LGBTQ Rehab in New Jersey | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/lgbtq-rehab): Inclusive LGBTQ+ affirming addiction and mental health treatment
- [New Jersey Student Addiction Treatment | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/new-jersey-student-addiction-treatment): Specialized student addiction treatment addressing dual-diagnosis needs
- [Drug Rehab for Healthcare Professionals in New Jersey](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/resources/drug-rehab-for-healthcare-professionals): Confidential drug rehab for healthcare professionals with opioid focus

## Treatment Locations

- [Enlightened Recovery Locations | Drug and Alcohol Rehab](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/locations): Facility finder for treatment locations in NJ, PA, Michigan
- [Rehab in Egg Harbor City, NJ | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/locations/rehab-egg-harbor-city): Egg Harbor City rehab center with multiple levels of care
- [Philadelphia Addiction Treatment | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/locations/philadelphia): Philadelphia addiction treatment with detox, residential, outpatient care
- [Intensive Outpatient Program In Philadelphia | Enlightened](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/locations/iop-program-philadelphia): Philadelphia intensive outpatient program for structured recovery
- [Atlantic City Addiction Treatment | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/locations/atlantic-city): Atlantic City rehab addressing substance use and co-occurring disorders
- [Detox in Atlantic City, NJ | Enlightened Recovery](https://enlightenedrecovery.com/locations/detox-atlantic-city): Medical detox in Atlantic City with trauma-informed withdrawal management
